answer: Clone keys cannot share a skyline watch. Each applicant draws one coastal mark and must film that mark's horizon from one posted tide turning to the next, with a fresh yarrow stalk on the lens cap in the first and last frames; internodes are the serial. The signed packet lists address, mark id, film hash, serial, and turning times. Filing costs 0.29 POA, with a 19 POA bond locked for 12 epochs. Auditors overlay the film on the official tide graph and re-count internodes. A reused serial, a drifted mark, or a turning more than six minutes late seizes the bond and suspends both keys.
